import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].dropna().unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, c=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder Status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df['Sleep Disorder Status'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Sleep Disorder Status', y='Stress Level', ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(occupation_sleep.values / occupation_sleep.max())
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(x=df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Overall Avg: {df["Quality of Sleep"].mean():.1f}')
ax3.legend(loc='lower right')

# Plot 4: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps colored by Heart Rate
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                       c=df['Heart Rate'], cmap='coolwarm', alpha=0.6, s=50)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps (colored by Heart Rate)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
